appDescription: Gildongmu lets drivers hear short voice messages that other drivers left on the road ahead, and leave their own for drivers heading the same way.

function.name: CONTROL_ROAD_MESSAGES
function.description: Listens to, skips, or stops the voice messages left on the road ahead.

command.description: What to do with the road messages: listen to them, skip to the next one, or stop listening.

function.name: THANK_ROAD_MESSAGE
function.description: Sends thanks to the driver who left the road message that was just played.

function.name: RECORD_ROAD_MESSAGE
function.description: Starts or finishes recording a short voice message at the current location for drivers heading the same way.
